title: The CSS Box Model knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying The CSS Box Model?
options: one utility expresses one CSS concern or a closely related behavior
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
questions.answer_key: one utility expresses one CSS concern or a closely related behavior
questions.explanation: The CSS Box Model is best understood through the syllabus topics: Content, padding, border, and margin, Box sizing, Width and height calculations. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with the css box model?
options: Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
combine meaningful utilities in markup and verify browser styles
questions.answer_key: combine meaningful utilities in markup and verify browser styles
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Content, padding, border, and margin, Box sizing, Width and height calculations, The relationship between spacing utilities and element dimensions.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying the css box model?
options: Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
visual styling does not replace semantic HTML or actual interactive behavior
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
questions.answer_key: visual styling does not replace semantic HTML or actual interactive behavior
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
